d.ko: Battleplan is a historical, WW2 real-time strategy game of unparalleled realism and simulation. Fight across massive battlefields created from real-world geographic data. Create your army by customizing your order of battle and chain of command. Draw directly on the map to create elaborate plans.

d.zh: 《Battleplan》是一款历史向二战即时战略游戏，拥有无与伦比的真实感和模拟度。玩家可以在基于真实地理数据打造而成的庞大战场上尽情作战。自定义作战序列和指挥链，组建属于你的军队。直接在地图上进行绘制，制定周密的作战计划，并交给麾下军官执行。
